bucket_contract.bucket_targets: non-negative JSON numbers summing to 1.0 over the declared scope
bucket_contract.bucket_members: keys exactly match bucket_targets; every active symbol appears exactly once, or — when denominator is declared — every active NON-CASH symbol appears exactly once
bucket_contract.cash_rule: a cash bucket must contain exactly one cash position and may not mix cash and non-cash positions (legacy form only)
bucket_contract.denominator_rule: optional; the only accepted value is active_non_cash_market_value. When declared, excluded_policy_symbols must list every active cash position with a non-empty reason, non-cash symbols may not be excluded, and bucket_targets apply to the non-cash scope. This mirrors the user-confirmed 80/20 denominator and avoids inventing a cash target or a fake zero variance for cash.
